headline: When focus won't come—quick resets and permission to pause
universal_truth: Not every day is a high-focus day; accepting this reduces the stress that makes it worse
fun_facts: Focus fluctuates naturally throughout the day and across days
A 2-minute movement break can reset attention more than pushing through
Sleep, hydration, and stress all significantly impact focus capacity
discussion_questions: What usually helps you reset your focus?
Are you being kind to yourself about today's difficulty?
What might your unfocused brain be telling you?

hook.script: Your brain won't cooperate today. Thoughts scatter. Attention wanders. You're here because focus isn't happening. That's okay. Let's try some quick resets—and also give you permission to pause if needed.

cliff.script: Should you push through or step away? What's the right move when focus won't come?

options.text: Try a reset first, then decide—sometimes a short break, movement, or change of environment restores focus; if not, permission to pause is valid too
options.response: Good approach. Let's try a quick reset. If it works, great. If not, today might be a rest day—and that's okay. Rest is part of sustainable learning.
Sometimes that works, but forced focus often produces poor retention. Let's try a reset first...

fact1.title: The 2-Minute Reset
fact1.script: Stand up. Stretch your arms overhead. Take three deep breaths. Look at something distant for 20 seconds. Sit back down. This simple sequence often restores attention by resetting your nervous system.

fact2.title: Check the Basics
fact2.script: Have you eaten? Are you hydrated? When did you last sleep well? Sometimes focus problems are really body problems. Meet physical needs before demanding mental performance.

fact3.title: Permission to Pause
fact3.script: If resets don't work, this might not be your day for focused learning. That's allowed. Missing one day doesn't break your streak of effort. Rest, and come back tomorrow refreshed.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Your brain isn't a machine. It has rhythms and limits. Respecting those limits makes sustainable learning possible.

outro.script: How's your focus now? If better, continue your learning. If not, take the day off with full permission. Either choice is valid. See you tomorrow.

growTrack.title: Focus Reset - Try It Now
growTrack.activity: Do the 2-minute reset: Stand, stretch, breathe, look distant, sit. Then check: water? food? sleep? If focus returns, continue. If not, rest guilt-free.
